batch.description: Jahangirnagar University D Unit (Biological Sciences), academic session 2023-2024, Set-P — full 80-question paper transcribed by direct visual reading of the Udvash 'জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক' (JU A & D Unit question bank, 2015–2025), book PDF pp.105-108 (printed book pp.104-107): questions on pp.105-108, printed answer table ('উত্তরমালা') and selected printed worked solutions on p.108. The book prints NO subject headings for this paper; subject blocks follow the printed question order — English Q1-4, IQ Q5-8, Bangla Q9-12, Zoology Q13-34, Chemistry Q35-58, Botany Q59-80 — matching the established JU D Unit split (Chemistry 24, Botany 22, Zoology 22, Bangla 4, English 4, IQ 4). Botany/Zoology are recorded as canonical subject Biology with the split kept in topic; Biology numbering runs continuously in printed order (Zoology block first, then Botany). EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions are marked content-UNVERIFIED and all keyed answers answer-UNVERIFIED — the printed publisher answer keys are preserved as-is and are NOT official JU keys; cross-source verification is a later stage. Exceptions: Q44 and Q64 carry answerDisposition 'no_correct_option' because the printed answer table shows a dash for both AND the book's printed worked solutions explicitly state there is no correct answer (Q44: 'Solution: (No Correct Ans.)', deriving oxidation number +3, which is not among the options; Q64: 'সমাধান: উত্তর নেই।'); for these two, answerVerificationStatus is 'verified' only in the validator's sense that the no-correct-option disposition itself is the book's printed claim — their content remains unverified. Q6 and Q8 depend on printed figures (not reproduced in text; described in extractionNote). Anomalies preserved as printed: Q76's third option is mislabelled '(b)' in the book (duplicate label; options recorded in positional order); 'সাম্যাঙ্ক' in Q54 options; 'Rhizobium lentis' (Q61, option d); 'Charles Laveron' (Q62, option c); backslash in 'g\100 g H2O' (Q50 stem); apostrophe-like mark after 'সমাণু' (Q38 stem). IMPORT COPY: verified subset (40/80) - see VERIFICATION report.

sourceDocuments.title: Udvash জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক (JU A & D Unit question bank, 2015–2025)
sourceDocuments.notes: Publisher question-bank book (Udvash Academic & Admission Care), scanned PDF, 295 pp. Set-P of JU D Unit 2023-2024 occupies book PDF pp.105-108 (printed book pp.104-107): questions on all four pages (Q1-22 p.105, Q23-47 p.106, Q48-71 p.107, Q72-80 p.108), printed answer table ('উত্তরমালা ও ব্যাখ্যামূলক সমাধান') on p.108 followed on the same page by selected printed worked solutions (Q1-6, 25, 40, 42, 43, 44, 50, 55, 58, 64, 68). The next paper (JU D Unit 2022-2023, Set-O) begins on book PDF p.109 and was NOT transcribed into this pack. Transcription by direct visual reading of every page image, with zoomed re-reads of the answer table, the figure questions and all formula-dense items; OCR drafts used only as finding aids. Mathematical notation linearised (^ for superscripts, subscripts inline, isotope notation with Unicode prescripts).
